'''Ogier groves''' are groups of trees that were planted after the [[Breaking of the World]]. They are located near places [[Ogier]] live or worked, particularly ''[[stedding]]'' and Ogier built cities such as [[Caemlyn]], [[Tar Valon]], and [[Manetheren]]. They were grown to add beauty to the world and to remind Ogier working in human cities of the ''stedding''. Ogier sometimes use the ones in their ''stedding'' as public meeting places. Many [[waygate]]s are located near places where groves once stood.  The Ogier Groves are said to contain every type of tree the Ogier could coax to grow in a given area.
